svg.title: Nightlight Press architecture
svg.desc: A parent orders on the shop; the Cashier takes payment; a Postgres job queue hands short jobs to twelve desks (Naïve agents, Monid, AgentMail, Mobilerun and plain code); four clocks plus self-continuation keep it moving; every step is a line in a hash-chained public ledger shown on the board and in the 3D office.
svg.text: Nightlight Press: how the company runs itself
Models write, paint and talk. Code decides when, whether and how much. Every step is a short job; every consequence is a ledger line.
the book goes back out: email + PDF, SMS, a read-aloud phone call, the nightly newsletter
orders a book on the web, $19

by email, with a read link
word limits by age, name on

calls to read the book aloud;
says it’s an AI, max 3 calls
every wake-up runs tick(): claim due jobs for ~6.5 s
On serverless nothing runs between requests, so after each tick the app POSTs /api/pulse to itself while work is due.
One lease in Postgres = one chain at a time; a depth cap means it can never loop forever. Books finish with nobody watching.
every step writes a ledger line
hash = sha256(canonical sorted-key JSON + prev hash)
Every human action is logged as an intervention. Anyone can re-verify the chain.
